text: No, sir, that is not the generals dog. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Yeldyrin thoughtfully. <break time="0.8s" /> Because the general has only big hunting dogs. <break time="0.8s" /> I know that myself. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Ochumelov. <break time="0.8s" /> For the generals dogs are expensive. <break time="0.8s" /> But this one has no fur. <break time="0.8s" /> And no shape at all. <break time="0.8s" /> If such an ugly dog were seen. <break time="0.8s" /> In Petersburg or Moscow. <break time="0.8s" /> People would get rid of it at once. <break time="0.8s" /> Without asking about the law. <break time="0.8s" /> Khryukin, you have been hurt. <break time="0.8s" /> And we cannot let this matter drop. <break time="0.8s" /> So the owner must be taught a lesson. <break time="0.8s" /> But it may be the generals dog after all. <break time="0.8s" /> Yeldyrin said, thinking aloud. <break time="0.8s" /> For the owners name is not written. <break time="0.8s" /> On a dogs face. <break time="0.8s" /> The other day I saw a dog just like this one. <break time="0.8s" /> In the yard of the house. <break time="0.8s" /> Where the general lives. <break time="0.8s" /> Of course it is the generals. <break time="0.8s" /> Shouted a voice from the crowd. <break time="0.8s" /> Hmm, Yeldyrin, help me on with my coat. <break time="0.8s" /> For a wind is getting up. <break time="0.8s" /> And I feel cold. <break time="0.8s" /> Take the dog to the generals house. <break time="0.8s" /> And ask there. <break time="0.8s" /> And tell them. <break time="0.8s" /> That I found it and sent it to them. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Ochumelov turned to Khryukin. <break time="0.8s" /> And shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> And you, put your silly finger down. <break time="0.8s" /> For it is your own fault.
